card.name: Key words in stock label sentences
card.fires_on: The word right before a stock label clause, mainly "whether" after "to determine" in geriatric use text and "harm" after "fetal" in pregnancy text.

modes.label: Geriatric use sentence
modes.description: "whether" after "to determine" in the line about too few subjects aged 65 and over.
modes.example: Clinical studies of rifabutin did not include sufficient numbers of subjects aged 65 and over to determine<< whether>> they respond differently from younger subjects.

modes.label: Fetal harm sentence
modes.description: "harm" after "fetal" in the pregnancy line about causing harm when given to a pregnant woman.
modes.example: It is not known whether gentamicin sulfate can cause fetal<< harm>> when administered to a pregnant woman or can
